import java.util.Scanner;

        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int[] A = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            A[i] = scanner.nextInt();
        }
        Arrays.sort(A);
        System.out.println(A[n / 2]);
        scanner.close();
    }
